body.x: PLACTICAL Co., Ltd. (CEO Yeon-Gu Kang) announced its participation in CES 2025 in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10, at the K-Startup Pavilion.

Founded in September 2023, PLACTICAL is an EdTech company focused on revolutionizing education for the digital-native generation. Led by a team of computer engineering experts from Kwangwoon University, the company specializes in developing educational platforms powered by AI technology.

PLACTICAL’s core product, ColonVerse Together, is an AI-driven platform that transforms traditional teaching materials into interactive, real-time educational content optimized for digital-native students. This reduces the burden on educators while increasing student engagement, offering a cutting-edge solution for modern classrooms.

The company also holds patents on flow-based programming education systems that integrate gaming content with education. Over 14,000 students across more than 200 educational institutions in South Korea currently use PLACTICAL’s platform, demonstrating its growing impact. Recognized for its innovation, PLACTICAL was awarded as a top-performing startup in the 2023 Ministry of SMEs and Startups’ Preliminary Startup Package. It completed a successful pilot with 11 schools through the 2024 EdTech SoftLab Project led by KERIS.

In addition to gaining recognition, PLACTICAL secured KRW 30 million in funding from Kwangwoon University’s Industry-Academic Cooperation Foundation in October 2023 and an additional KRW 300 million investment from the Korea Technology Finance Corporation in June 2024. Its technology was valued at KRW 438 million, underscoring its credibility and potential.

At CES 2025, PLACTICAL aims to establish a foothold in the global EdTech market by identifying emerging trends and exploring collaboration opportunities with leading companies. The company will focus on potential partnerships for AI-based automatic educational content generation technology. It also plans to validate the direction of ColonVerse Together, slated for release in 2025, and to build partnerships for its global expansion.

The centerpiece of PLACTICAL’s CES 2025 showcase is ColonVerse, an online collaborative coding game introducing a novel coding education method. Leveraging its proprietary node-coding technology, ColonVerse overcomes the limitations of traditional block-coding approaches. The game incorporates cooperative learning elements, boosting student engagement through real-time multiplayer experiences. PLACTICAL’s patent for this innovative programming education system further highlights its technological excellence.

PLACTICAL is preparing for market expansion in the U.S. and U.K., alongside plans to export its solutions to Southeast Asia, where Korean education is highly regarded. “The U.S. and U.K. are leading markets for EdTech innovation, offering significant growth opportunities for PLACTICAL. Southeast Asia, with its rapidly growing digital education infrastructure and trust in Korean education, presents an ideal secondary target for expansion,” said a company representative.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
